opportunities.name: Book a Resy special event ticket
opportunities.description: On Resy, open the Special Events & Experiences list for a given city, pick an event, choose a ticket quantity and ticket type or time slot, and reserve it.
steps: Open resy.com and set the city if it needs changing
Open the Special Events & Experiences list (from 'View all <city> restaurants' > Events, or 'See more')
Select the ticket quantity in the tickets dropdown
Click Book Now for the ticket type, or click the time-slot button
Click Reserve Now in the Complete Your Reservation dialog

steps: Click 'Check my bus' in the header
Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'

opportunities.name: Look up NPS park info by state
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use Find a Park by State to choose a state, then open an info link (Basic Information, Current Conditions, heritage area, etc.) for a park in that state.
steps: Click the 'Find a Park' 'By State...' dropdown
On the state page, find the park or category you want
Click its info link (Basic Information / Current Conditions / National Heritage Areas)
